line.en: glasgow's weekend market on gallowgate, open 10:00 to 16:00 on saturdays. vintage, records, old things; go before lunch for the best stalls.
line.de: glasgows wochenendmarkt an der gallowgate, samstags 10 bis 16 uhr. vintage, schallplatten, trödel; geh vor dem mittag für die besten stände.
line.tr: glasgow'un hafta sonu pazarı, gallowgate'te; cumartesileri 10:00 ile 16:00 arası açık. vintage, plak, eski eşya; en iyi stantlar için öğleden önce git.

sparks.why: The Barras market on Sat 7 Nov, listed as an additional date by eventslist.co.uk; regular Saturday hours 10:00 to 16:00 and the address 244 Gallowgate per the Barrowland market's own site.
